title: Staff of the Ram

sources.role: Rules: Staff of the Ram (passive feature)
sources.title: Staff of the Ram (passive feature)
markers: | description = Once per turn, the blow possibly knocks a foe back {{Dist|m=2|ft=6.5}} and {{Cond|Stunned|Stuns}} them. This has no effect on dragons or Huge creatures.

summary: +2 staff can push and stun a creature once per turn.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple, Versatile, 5 ft melee. 1d6 + 2 one-handed or 1d8 + 2 two-handed Bludgeoning plus Strength. +2 to attack rolls.
fields.Staff of the Ram: DC 8 Constitution save or pushed 7 ft and Stunned for 1 turn. No effect against Dragons or Huge creatures. The source reports the save can occur even on a missed attack or some other actions.
fields.Acquisition: Opulent chest behind a DC 18 locked bookcase in the basement.
fields.Topple: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Action, weapon attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. DEX save against weapon-action DC +2 or Prone for 1 turn. Prone breaks Concentration and expires at the start of the target’s turn. Topple skips main-hand weapon effects.
fields.Stunned: Cannot move, act or react and automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves. Attackers gain Advantage. Stun breaks Concentration. Freedom of Movement, Greater Restoration and Unshackling Strike can remove it.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
